pages.title: Loser
pages.text: Loser plays in Skitchin' when you're out of a race, whether the screen says Equipment Failure, Hospital or Arrested. If you also run out of money, the game simply says "Bogus!" In the spring of 1994, when the game came out, Beck's "Loser" was in the US top 10.

pages.title: Agnes on the sidelines
pages.text: Sometimes Skitchin's TV crew asks a woman on the sidelines, Agnes, what she thinks. "Wait until your mother hears about this," she says. Agnes once dreamed of you as a highly paid programmer, and now she suggests Scrabble instead.
